source.made: exported by stage 08 (seo_website_template scripts/export-site-collection.mjs); Site Factory copies it byte for byte to domain/site-collection.json
files: scripts/lib/site-collection.mjs (SITE_FACTS: Site Factory's own sentences, carried word for word)
source.rows: each item's what / recorded / why is dataPractices()'s row word for word (scripts/test/site-collection.test.mjs)
source.when: "always", or {switch: value}: the item is on when every switch has that value; the switches are Site Factory's project.yaml site_services over the defaults, resource_form on when the site has its resources page
source.labels: the words a privacy page sentence repeating the row would hold (Site Factory S07-12)

items.recorded: Your name, email and message; your company and phone if you give them; the details of your request if you give them (what it is about, how many, by when, a reference link), and that you agreed to this use
The page you sent it from, the page that linked you here (referrer) and any campaign tags in the link you followed (UTM)
items.why: To know which pages and campaigns bring enquiries

items.recorded: Your name, email and which resource; anything else you tell us, and that you agreed to this use; it carries the same page, referrer and campaign tags as an enquiry
items.why: To send you the resource you asked for

items.recorded: Pages viewed, the site you came from, browser, device type and country, and when a form is sent; counted without cookies and without identifying you
items.why: To see which pages help visitors

items.recorded: Your messages and, if you leave it, your email address
items.why: To answer you in the chat

items.recorded: Nothing on this site: the button opens WhatsApp with a message naming the page, and the conversation continues there under WhatsApp's terms
items.why: To answer you where you prefer

items.recorded: Your email address, when you subscribe
items.why: To send the newsletter; every issue has a link to unsubscribe

items.form: the enquiry form on this website
items.chat: the live chat on this website

attachments.label: Files and attachments
attachments.text: the forms on this website take no attachments; files are sent to us by email

resource_delivery.form: Visitors ask for a resource through the resource request form on this website, and we email it to them.
resource_delivery.files: These resources are files on this website for visitors to open: {names}.

site_facts.privacy_retention: We keep the details sent through this website for {retention}.
site_facts.privacy_contact: Questions about the details this website holds go to {contact}.
site_facts.privacy_rights: To see, correct or delete the details we hold about you, write to {contact}.
